caseName: Glick Bros. Lumber Co. v. Bowles
caseNameFull: Glick Brothers Lumber Co. v. Bowles, Price Administrator
attorneys: Mr. Morris Lavine for petitioners. Assistant Solicitor General Cox and Mr. David London for respondent.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit denied for failure to comply with par. 2 of Rule 38 of the Rules of this Court. The brief filed in support of the petition is not “direct and concise” as required by that rule.
